narrative: Material PL1__MB382F9E exhibits erratic demand (CV=0.68, 78% non-zero days) with a mild declining trend of -0.64 units/day and unstable lead times (CV=0.42). The current SAP safety stock of 100 units is severely under-buffered relative to the sigma_LTD of 321 units required for 95% service level. An (r,Q) continuous-review policy with SS=528, ROP=1080, and OQ=2371 (storage-capped from EOQ of 2402) reduces total annual cost by 76% by consolidating ~198 annual orders into ~20, while the safety stock increase ensures the service level target is met under demand and lead time volatility.

research_insights.selection_rationale: Erratic demand with unstable lead times requires continuous inventory monitoring rather than periodic review. EOQ minimises the sum of ordering and holding costs; the MOQ of 240 is well below the EOQ of 2402, so no MOQ conflict arises. The (r,Q) structure directly incorporates sigma_LTD into the safety stock, providing a statistically grounded 95% service level guarantee.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Storage cap (2899 units) reduced the order quantity by 31 units from the unconstrained EOQ of 2402 to 2371. The annual cost impact is marginal (~$40). The cap is non-binding for safety stock. Service level is unaffected.
research_insights.escalation_flag: None — MOQ (240) + safety stock (528) = 768 units, well within the 2899-unit storage limit. No infeasibility conflict.
